facts.fact: Rack Centre, a carrier-neutral colocation data centre in Lagos, has operated since its launch in October 2013 with 100% uptime claimed by the operator.

Rack Centre in Lagos is described by its operator as Tier III Constructed Facility certified (Uptime Institute-style constructed-facility certification, the first in Africa); the document gives no certification date, so the page date is used.
